Thanks for the interest — excited to run through Redwood Inference with your team. To make sure we include the right stakeholders (SE deep-dive + procurement + security), can you confirm which of these windows work for a 60-min technical demo followed by a 30-min procurement/security Q&A (we can split into two invites if you prefer)?

Candidate windows (we're proposing a rotating weekly cadence to spread timezones):
- Option A (Americas-friendly): Thu 11/11 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
- Option B (EMEA-friendly): Fri 11/12 16:00 CET / 11:00 ET
- Option C (APAC-friendly): Mon 11/15 08:30 SGT / Sun 11/14 16:30 PT

Attached is a quick availability grid and a draft multi-window invite (.ics). If none of these are possible we can do a one-off and then switch to a rotation across weeks (Week 1: Americas, Week 2: EMEA, Week 3: APAC).

Also: who on your side should own the security questionnaire? If you can loop them in, we'll send SOC2 artifacts and the standard security packet ahead of the demo.

Next steps: please reply with preferred option(s) and any additional attendees (security/procurement contacts). We'll lock the calendar and share a calendar matrix so everyone sees the rotation.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
